{{Quote|All ships, this is General Bel Iblis. We've just been informed that a strong Frezhlix force is moving on the Sif'krie homeworld of Sif'kric.|[[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]]|<ref name="SotP" />}}
'''Sif'kric''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mezeg sector/Legends|Mezeg sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. This planet was attacked during the [[Caamas Document Crisis]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Corran, what are these pommwomm plants you mentioned?''"<br />"''They're a type of hot-world shrub that grows on the system's inner planet. You can get about eight different exotic medicines and twice that number of food flavorings out of them.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]|<ref name="SotP" />}}
Sif'kric was home to the [[Sif'krie]]s, a people who were constantly feuding with the [[Frezh]]lix who shared the [[Sif'kric system/Legends|Sif'kric system]] with them. Sif'kric was one of the outer worlds in the [[Sif'kric system/Legends|Sif'kric system]]. An inner [[Pommwomm homeworld|world]] was a hot-world where [[pommwomm]] plants were grown and exported to Sif'kric annually. These plants were the basis of the Sif'kric economy.<ref name="SotP" />

==History==
{{Quote|Ten to one it's the Frezhlix; they've been feuding with the Sif'kries ever since we chased the Empire out of the area.|Corran Horn|<ref name="SotP" />}}
During the [[Caamas Document Crisis]], in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the Frezhlix [[Blockade of Sif'kric|blockaded]] the planet Sif'kric. The Frezhlix justification was the Sif'krie's opposition to the [[Drashtine Initiative]] in their [[sector assembly]], demanding that the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] pay reparations for the [[Caamas Firestorm|destruction]] of [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]]. Up to 20% of their yearly pommwomm production was at risk of being wiped out, but the blockade was broken by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces under [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]].<ref name="SotP" />
